claimed_purpose.text: Evaluate open-domain dialogue models in a long-term, multi-session conversation setting where partners learn about each other's interests across sessions.

mechanisms.text: Sessions are numbered 1–5. Session 1 is ConvAI2 (PersonaChat). Sessions 2–4 have train/valid/test splits; session 5 has only valid/test. Train data does not exist beyond session 4.
Data files are split into train.txt, valid.txt, and test.txt under a session-specific directory path.
Dataset is human-human, collected as multiple chat sessions with cross-session knowledge sharing.

ledger.claim: MSC is a human-human dataset of multiple chat sessions focused on long-term open-domain conversation.
ledger.quote: we collect and release a human-human dataset consisting of multiple chat sessions whereby the speaking partners learn about each other's interests and discuss the things they have learnt from past sessions
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: MSC has train, valid, and test splits implemented as train.txt, valid.txt, and test.txt per session.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Session 1 is PersonaChat/ConvAI2; MSC sessions 2–4 extend it across multiple sessions; session 5 exists only for valid/test; no train data exists for session 5.
ledger.quote:
assert opt['session_id'] <= 5, f"No data beyong session {opt['session_id']}!"
assert (
    opt['session_id'] <= 4 or 'train' not in opt['datatype']
), f"No train data beyong session {opt['session_id']}!"
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Each data record contains dialog turns, previous_dialogs (prior sessions), personas, init_personas, metadata with initial_data_id, and time gap (time_num, time_unit) between sessions.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Gold persona summaries are from crowdworkers; predicted summaries are from a separate summarization model loaded from a JSON file.
ledger.quote:
"the 'goldsum_' prefix refers to gold persona summaries from crowdworkers; "
"the 'predsum_' prefix refers to predicted persona summaries from a summarization model"
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Temporal reasoning is supported: time elapsed since last session (time_num/time_unit in hours or days) can be injected into model context.
ledger.quote:
'--include-time-gap', type=bool, default=False, help="whether to include time passed since last conversation in the context"
...
'time_unit': bot_first_entry['time_unit']
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Persona summarization task uses subsampled negative (no-persona) examples during training; subsampling is disabled at test time.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: No train data exists beyond session 3 in the persona summarization task.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Human evaluation used a per-turn protocol; context for bots was generated from MSC sessions to seed crowdsourced human-human follow-up conversations.
ledger.quote: This generator was used to generate the context information shown to bots at the beginning of a conversation, when crowdsourcing the conversations that for per-turn human evaluation.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The default teacher (DefaultTeacher) is MscTeacher, which aggregates sessions 2–4 for training.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The MSC task is implemented within ParlAI under parlai/tasks/msc, with constituent files including agents.py, build.py, constants.py, mutators.py, and test.py, indicating a structured task/eval harness.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: PersonaSummary sub-task has 130k train and 25k valid examples
ledger.quote: dialog summary for multi-session chat data (session 1-4, with 130k train examples and 25k valid examples)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Retrieval-augmented and summarization-based models outperform standard encoder-decoder baselines on this benchmark
ledger.quote: retrieval-augmented methods and methods with an ability to summarize and recall previous conversations outperform the standard encoder-decoder architectures currently considered state of the art
ledger.label: inferred
